title: Elon Musk on the Early Days of Tesla: Interview Part 1
summary: A long interview with Elon Musk at Gigafactory Texas on Tesla's early days, covering why electric vehicles, who founded Tesla, founder departures, Roadster engineering and early funding.
why: Cited as Musk's own account of Tesla's founding and early financial struggles, often in disputes over the company's history.

quote.text: in this interview he talks about the fact he had “no money” and had to borrow money for rent around that time
